newsitem.title: USA: Lufthansa, UAL cargo fly lioness to Chicago.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa, UAL cargo fly lioness to Chicago.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo and United Airline's cargo said they have co-operated with the Lincoln Park zoo in Chicago in bringing to bring a nine month-old lioness to the zoo from a South African wildlife reserve.
The intention is to introduce the lioness called Myra to Adelor, the zoo's African lion, in an effort to breed the species.

The two animals represent bloodlines that are entirely new to American zoos. By helping maintain the genetic diversity of the African lion, the three organisations are making a significant contribution to the long term survival of the species, they added. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
